intro: The Waves Advance is built for busy families. With five-tier storage, ventilated shutters, and a spacious top, we’ve made it easy to keep every pair organised while adding style to your entryway.

features.title: Four tiers to keep every pair in place
features.text: We’ve designed a spacious four-tier layout that fits all your family’s footwear up to 20 pairs, from everyday sneakers to seasonal favourites—so no pair gets left behind.

features.title: Ventilated back for fresher shoes
features.text: Say goodbye to musty odours. Our ventilated back hole promote airflow, helping keep your shoes fresh and dry, even after a long day.

features.title: Built strong for daily wear with elevated design
features.text: We know storage needs to last. That’s why we’ve crafted a sturdy, durable cabinet that stands up to daily use while the elevated design helps to keep it clean without losing its style.

features.title: A spacious drawer for extra convenience
features.text: More than just shoe storage—our wide top surface with added drawer gives you space for keys, bags, or decorative accents, making your entryway feel complete.

features.title: A sleek finish that fits right in
features.text: Designed to complement any home, our warm wood and neutral tones add a modern, polished touch to your entryway.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
